description: Scavengers Reach is an immense field of rusted wreckage under a distant planet and its smaller companion in the sky. Broken hull plates, shattered frames, wheels and machinery rise in heaps on both sides of a dusty central track. The path climbs towards an orange-lit horizon, where more ruined structures silhouette against the sky. The foreground is full of angular metal, cables and half-buried parts rather than neat stacks of cargo. Rust browns, ash greys and the low light make the wreck field feel expansive, while the gap between the heaps gives the eye a route into its distance.
